caption: The drawing depicts a single rectangular, flat object, which appears to be a tile or a slab, centrally positioned on a plain, light beige background. The tile is predominantly an earthy orange color, with darker brown and greenish stains, spots, and irregular marks scattered across its surface, suggesting age or wear. There are five identical embossed or engraved motifs on the tile: one in the center and one in each of the four corners. Each motif resembles a rosette or wheel with radiating segments and a small circular hub in the middle. The lines of the motifs are drawn in a darker shade of brown or green, providing contrast against the orange base. The edges of the tile are defined by a slightly darker outline, and there are visible cracks and chips, particularly noticeable towards the bottom left and upper edge, which enhance the appearance of texture and dimension.
title: Zoar Fireplace Tile
